pure-announcement.rationale: This is the vendor's own launch post — 'Today, we're introducing... available today in public beta' — whose substance is feature positioning, availability and internal benchmark deltas; the underlying techniques get their durable treatment in the separate context-engineering essay, not here.

duplicate.rationale: None of the supplied nearest concepts (context layer, LLM-maintained wiki, MCP notes) covers platform-level context editing or the memory tool.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The features are documented at linked docs pages, so the descriptive claims are checkable even if the internal eval numbers are not.

durability.rationale: Beta status, 'best model in the world' positioning, and internal eval deltas (39%, 84%) churn quickly; only the one-line mechanism descriptions of tool-result clearing and file-based memory transfer.

actionability.rationale: The only action offered is product adoption — enable the beta features and read the docs — with no transferable how-to beyond that.

atomicity.rationale: One coherent announcement: two features presented as a single context-management capability.
